tooltip.dreamworld.dream_clay.1: Smelt it into a dream crystal.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_crystal.1: Grind it into dream powder, or use it to craft dream alloy.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_powder.1: Brew it into dream tea, or combine it with a painting to make dream graffiti.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_tea.2: Sleep with Dream Walk to enter the dream world; the effect is not consumed by entering or leaving.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_alloy.1: Used to craft the dream alloy sword, shovel, wand and spear.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_alloy_sword.1: A lethal hit sends the creature to the other side.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_alloy_sword.2: The only weapon that can strike creatures inside the dream.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_alloy_shovel.1: The only tool that can mine blocks inside the dream.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_alloy_shovel.2: Breaking a block triggers a dream intrusion.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_alloy_wand.1: Hold right-click to charge, then release to blast the crosshair.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_alloy_wand.2: Longer charge means a bigger explosion and more damage.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_alloy_wand.3: The blast sends blocks and lethally hit creatures to the other side.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_alloy_spear.1: It pins itself on impact and force-loads its chunk.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_alloy_spear.2: The spear marks a dream anchor.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_alloy_spear.3: Each player can have only one thrown spear.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_graffiti.1: Exists in both the dream and reality.
tooltip.dreamworld.dream_graffiti.2: Pairs of graffiti form dream tunnels.
tooltip.dreamworld.blub_spawn_egg.1: Blubs produce dream clay and follow dream tea.
hud.dreamworld.destroy_anchor: Sneak + right-click to destroy the bound anchor
hud.dreamworld.tunnel_enter: Interact to enter the dream tunnel
